text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...*Pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Am I still... afraid
of the sheer strength you wielded?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, hehe.
.........Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I will definitely never forgive you—!!

Following the Satsuki Sho, a certain trend
had begun to emerge around Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Her too.

Satono Crown pointed at one of her classmates.
If I recall correctly, she specializes in front-running, but...
choice_data_list: That's... practice for a Front Runner.
That's... practice for a Front Runner, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
That training was meant to build up enough stamina to go the distance even from the lead.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...That's not her usual frontal assault.
It's an unorthodox tactic designed purely
to counter Duramente's late-stage kick."

"That feeling of being ambushed by Duramente
that Satono Crown experienced in the Satsuki Sho."

It was deeply engraved into the hearts of those
who ran in the same race, and those who watched it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There are clearly a lot of girls who adopt
a more forward, earlier strategy
out of caution against that finishing burst.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It seems other Betweener and Chaser girls
might actually have a strategy to mark her
real closely instead.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Either way, it's unavoidable that the race will revolve around Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Given all that,
what strategy do you recommend for me?"
choice_data_list: The textbook strategy is to keep Duramente marked
Marking Duramente is the textbook strategy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
It's bound to be a high-paced race.
Better to hold back and stalk rather than lead. Prioritizing marking the leaders is the best strategy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...? Dia?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah. No.
I just thought both of you seemed so calm...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Should I have been more shaken?
Like, 'A formidable rival has appeared!'

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh!? That's—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu. You're so honest, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The more you panic, the harder it is for
your mind to come up with inspiration.
To produce good ideas, you must first calm down.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Dia. As for me...
"I'm relaxed, and in perfect condition."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, your debut race is after autumn, right?
Then getting your body in proper shape is your top priority.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Stop fussing over us
and pay attention to yourself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...! Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ......Well, then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
If I were to mark Duramente-san,
do you think I could overtake her?
choice_data_list: We won't know until we try.

text_block_list.text:
If there is even a shred of possibility,
there is no reason to shake one's head.
Even if the result may be――
—Even if it created the undeniable reality that, ever since the Satsuki Sho, Satono Crown had not crossed the line ahead of Duramente once in training.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Haven't you gotten faster again?
I'm pretty sure I would've beaten
the you from two days ago.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Because there are those who'll go out of their way
to volunteer as your sparring partner."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Yikes...
That backfired completely...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Crown, I—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—I will transcend everything.
The me of the Satsuki Sho,
and you, who will surely come to the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Nooow then, what should we do?
Marking that girl seems pretty pointless, though."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Are you still going to keep aiming for first place?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win the Derby too.
However, obsessing over first place might cost you a podium position you could have secured, wouldn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's the same whether in business or racing.
If you stay overconfident in what you can handle,
you'll stretch yourself too thin and your performance will drop.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "And so, far from getting second place, you might not even make the board."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Then even if you can't take first, aim for a run that secures second or third.
—That's still a wonderful strategy, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Finishing 2nd in the Derby is an achievement to be plenty proud of.
It'll go on your record as a Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...So, how is it?

The Nippon Derby has a long final straight,
making the late-race burst of speed the ultimate key.

"If that's the case, Duramente with her overwhelming closing speed
has the greatest advantage.
...Every camp acknowledges that."

On top of that, Satono Crown just lost to Duramente in a contest of late speed.
If that's the case, then in the real race...
I want to see a future where Satono Crown wins.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Even so, you still claim that I can "win"?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Ufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I love that about you.
—After all, we're two of a kind.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Didn't I tell you?
I will bring Satono the greatest glory.
Not just a GⅠ victory, but brilliance beyond even that."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In this desperate pinch, if I could only claim victory
over an Umamusume that everyone trembles in fear of...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Glory will rain down upon Satono.
As the house that produced such a supreme Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime chance like this
doesn't come around often, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: …………――This is fun.

text_block_list.name: Video Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Brian surges forward in an instant!
Coming wide from the outside, it's Narita Brian!
Narita Brian takes the lead!!"
Skipping the post-training meeting, I scour my room for footage of Derby Umamusume.

――Above all, the runs of those geniuses who were the favorites in the Derby
and seized the pinnacle with their explosive closing speed.
choice_data_list: There has to be a clue somewhere. The next footage is...

text_block_list.name: Video Commentary
text_block_list.text: "And on the outside is Tokai Teio. Tokai Teio is in sixth to seventh position. Tightly marking Teio is—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can recite the rest of that live commentary by heart!
Kita-chan watched Teio-san's races so many times that I ended up memorizing it!

text_block_list.name: Dia & Video Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Tokai Teio is on the outside! Teio on the outside!
She's breaking through all at once from the outside!!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
My, wonderful!
That's correct!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...
...By the way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
You're anxious about Kura-chan's gate position in the Derby, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I believe part of it was that Teio-san drew an outside gate and was forced to run on the outside.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I managed to take 1st place, but
I ran pretty wide on the outside and took a distance penalty because of it, so..."
choice_data_list: Still, running on the outside isn't entirely a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?

For instance... the more an Umamusume is seen
as overwhelmingly superior, the tighter she will be marked.

"When that happens, you end up surrounded by other Umamusume on all sides while running...
and when you want to make your move, it's hard to break out to the front."
choice_data_list: If you're on the outside, it's easier to avoid that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see...! So for a popular Umamusume, it can actually be advantageous at times.

In addition, Umamusume like Narita Brian, who
possess a fearless nature and stand out in ability,
often tend to launch their attacks from far outside.

Even if it means the disadvantage of taking the wide outside,
her team must judge that the benefits outweigh the extra distance.
choice_data_list: Maybe Duramente will do the same

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey.
Trainer, is that—

Right then, inspiration struck.
This—might just work for Satono Crown's races!!
